name: OpenHands CLI
desc: OpenHands agents driven from your own terminal.
desc_zh: 在你自己终端里驱动 OpenHands 智能体的命令行工具。
solves: The web workspace is another window to switch to; the same agent runs beside your shell where the work already happens.
solves_zh: 网页工作区是另一个要切过去的窗口；同一个智能体就在你已经干活的终端旁边跑。
best_for: You live in the terminal and want the agent started with one command in the repo.
best_for_zh: 平时就住在终端里，想在仓库里一条命令把智能体拉起来。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — openhands.dev/blog directory）。 Predates the window but is absent from the ledger, so it is recorded under rule (b). 首次公开日期来源：https://www.openhands.dev/blog/the-openhands-cli-ai-powered-development-in-your-terminal
